method: no new search — checked against the evidence already recorded for msa_ca_prop65, which propagation.mjs named as the clause this one was built from. The question was whether the same defect is present, and the sources establishing it are already on file.

assertions.text: review the catalogue annually and confirm warnings are present and correctly placed
a warning that is present but non-conforming is treated as no warning
assertions.note: the same overstatement confirmed in msa_ca_prop65 — a non-conforming warning loses the safe harbour rather than being void as such

assertions.text: enforcement is primarily by private plaintiffs who recover attorney’s fees, preceded by a sixty-day notice

gaps: The parent defect propagated: this clause states the duty with no threshold, and Proposition 65 does not apply to a business employing fewer than ten employees. Both clauses in this pair tell the reader most likely to be exempt that they are covered.

sources.title: California OEHHA — Are any businesses exempt from Proposition 65?
